title: A variational physics-informed graph neural network for heterogeneous solid mechanics
abstract: arXiv:2609.10983v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stress localization in heterogeneous solids is governed by the bimaterial interface, where the displacement field remains $C^0$-continuous, while in-plane stresses jump due to the stiffness mismatch. Coordinate-based physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) represent this jump via a prescribed regularization width or a weighted interface penalty, making their accuracy sensitive to how phase-contrast changes are handled. This work presents a variational, label-free physics-informed graph neural network (PI-GNN) in which the heterogeneity is carried by the discretization rather than by the trial field. The solver operates on a conforming adaptive mesh graph, assigns constitutive behavior per element, and minimizes the discrete total potential energy as a single unweighted objective in which only first derivatives appear. translated_title: 一种用于非均质固体力学的变分物理信息图神经网络
translated_abstract: 非均质固体中的应力局部化由双材料界面控制，在界面处位移场保持 $C^0$ 连续，而面内应力则因刚度失配而发生跳跃。基于坐标的物理信息神经网络（PINN）通过预设的正则化宽度或加权界面惩罚来表示这种跳跃，使其精度对如何处理相间对比变化非常敏感。本工作提出了一种变分的、无标签的物理信息图神经网络（PI-GNN），其中非均质性由离散化而非试探场来承载。该求解器在协调的自适应网格图上运行，为每个单元分配本构行为，并将离散总势能作为单一无权重目标函数进行最小化，其中仅出现一阶导数。分段线性单元上的离散能量与有限元（FE）Ritz 泛函完全一致。
tldr: 该论文提出一种变分无标签的物理信息图神经网络（PI-GNN），将非均质性由离散化承载而非试探场，通过在自适应网格图上最小化离散总势能这一单一无权重目标，准确捕捉双材料界面处的应力跳跃。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a variational, label-free physics-informed graph neural network (PI-GNN) that carries heterogeneity through the discretization rather than the trial field, minimizing the discrete total potential energy on a conforming adaptive mesh graph to accurately capture stress jumps across bimaterial interfaces.
